name: The Peninsula Beijing
positioning: All-suite luxury hotel in Wangfujing, steps from the Forbidden City, with Cantonese dining at Huang Ting and a shopping arcade
best_for: Travelers who want a central Beijing base near the Forbidden City
Travelers interested in Cantonese dining and Chinese tea culture

facts.text: The hotel is in Wangfujing, steps from the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square.
The hotel is an all-suite property pairing residential layouts with contemporary Chinese art.
Duplex Suites stretch across two stories.
The hotel's three restaurants are The Lobby, Huang Ting and Yun Summer Lounge.
Huang Ting's menu moves between Cantonese classics and regional Chinese specialties, from dim sum to Peking duck.
Yun Summer Lounge offers open-air dining and cocktails.
The indoor swimming pool is heated to 28 degrees Celsius year round.
The spa offers treatments inspired by Ayurvedic, European and Asian healing philosophies, with spa suites for couples and thermal bathing facilities.
The hotel has an art gallery on the third floor with rotating exhibitions.
The hotel's fleet includes six BMW 7 Series saloons for airport transfers and private hire.
The Peninsula Arcade, the hotel's shopping arcade, has grown to three levels with over 30 brands.

highlights.text: The Peninsula Suite is designed to resemble a Chinese aristocrat's courtyard home in old Beijing.
The Huang Ting Tea Lounge serves more than 20 varieties of tea, with a resident tea master preparing tastings in the style of a traditional Chinese tea ceremony.
Huang Ting reinterprets the courtyard houses of Beijing's nobility, with Qing dynasty antiques and silk accents.
Guests can explore the hutongs of the old town and imperial landmarks on Peninsula bicycles.
The hotel was the first in China to collaborate with skincare brand Biologique Recherche.

considerations.text: The spa does not accept children under 16.
The hotel is 27.4 km from Beijing Capital International Airport and 52 km from Beijing Daxing International Airport.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
